# Pocket Closet

> A wardrobe companion for iOS and Android. Photograph pieces, catalog a closet, compose outfits, and preview looks with try-on.

Pocket Closet is a software product with a public marketing website. This site describes the app; it is not a store, marketplace, or review aggregator.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product landing page with features, screenshot placeholders, and store download calls to action
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms for the websites, iOS and Android apps, and related services
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How the operator handles wardrobe photos, try-on previews, accounts, and optional website analytics
- [Contact us](/contact): Public form for product questions and support requests to the operator

## Notes

- App Store and Play Store buttons stay disabled until public store URLs are configured for a deployment
- Optional Google Analytics and Meta Pixel load only when public environment identifiers are set
- Structured data describes a SoftwareApplication. It does not include ratings, reviews, or other unverified claims
